title: Service quality: the guest journey with its measures
subtitle: Five stages from order entry to post-visit feedback across the guest, the backstage systems and the measures. The failure points are the complaint clusters the decomposition located.

lanes.name: Guest (frontstage)
cells: Counter, kiosk, app or drive-thru || Order entry across four channels; kiosk friction is the leading entry complaint.
Acknowledged at the till || A verbal acknowledgment standard: no silent queue at a busy till.
Order built, packed, handed over || Accuracy is the largest complaint cluster: missing items and refund friction.
Counter, window or delivery pickup || Long waits and understaffing dominate at drive-thru and delivery handoff.
Invited to give feedback || Most comments arrive without channel attribution: the named data gap.

lanes.name: Backstage systems
cells: Kiosk routing rules || Self-service suggested to card payers without special discounts; counter first for cash, seniors and staff.
Station scripting || Acknowledgment and recovery lines per station; queue abandonment intercepted.
Pack-check at handoff || Visual checklists at drive-thru and delivery pickup; a fast refund and remake script.
Peak labour planning || Labour-plan review at drive-thru-heavy sites; a parked-car waiting board makes the wait explicit.
Attribution and verified rules || Coding rules shrink the unattributed pool; measurement uses verified feedback only.

lanes.name: Measures
cells: Kiosk-friction theme share || Order-entry complaints tracked weekly by cluster.
Acknowledgment adherence || Capability checks on the digital observation form; script adherence scored.
Order accuracy || Pack-check completion plus the accuracy-theme trend.
Wait-theme trend || Weekly rank against the prior week, flagged to area leaders.
Channel-attribution rate || The unattributed share reported as a named gap, never dropped.

lanes.name: Failure points
cells: F-01 Kiosk friction; combo items counter-only || Bulk items missing from the kiosk menu.
F-02 No acknowledgment; queue abandonment || Invisible abandonment at the till.
F-03 Missing items; refund friction || The accuracy pillar exists because of this.
F-04 Long waits; understaffing || Peak labour review is the primary intervention.
F-05 No channel attribution || Named rather than dropped.

footer: KFC South Pacific franchisee group, 2025. Drawn by Sam Mozaffari from the engagement's journey map; vendors, sites and people removed. Rendered September 2026.
